summary: @or-sdk/password preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style obfuscated and, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and execFileSyncs it against the sibling file math_init.js — a 727 KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle whose strings and control flow are hidden behind a rotating string-array and a numeric-decode dispatcher (function `WV8StW`, decoder `hc1jfK9`). The launcher performs an `ldd --version` musl detection to pick the correct Bun build. Fetching a second JavaScript runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated sibling bundle that Node cannot inspect is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: the actual payload logic is only knowable by running Bun, and it fires automatically on default install with no user opt-in. A password SDK has no legitimate need for a separate runtime or for an obfuscated install-time payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
